title: Saudi Arabian Date Tagine
description: A traditional Saudi Arabian dessert made with juicy dates and fragrant tagine spices. This easy-to-make tagine is perfect for warm weather and special occasions.
instructions: Rinse the dates and remove any pits.
In a large pot, combine the dates, tagine spices, and water.
Bring the mixture to a boil over medium heat.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10-15 minutes.
Stir in the honey until dissolved.
Serve the tagine warm or at room temperature.
